verdict.rationale: Rootly's workflow engine includes a Jira action category and automations that can 'file tickets,' and AI summaries reference 'action items' as part of incident data, suggesting follow-up items can be pushed to an issue tracker. However there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated follow-up/action-item tracking view, no evidence of bi-directional status sync (e.g., ticket closed → item marked done), and no confirmation beyond Jira for other trackers. missing for 10: dedicated action-item/follow-up tracking module, documented two-way sync of ticket status back into Rootly, and evidence covering trackers beyond Jira.
